title: Fuzzing harness design
signals: raw bytes must become structured input
preconditions: the target entry point is callable in-process
state can be reset per input
steps: Identify the deepest stable entry point after initialization; call it, not `main`, when possible.
Map bytes to arguments deterministically; initialize all structs and reset globals per input.
Cap input size, avoid file/network I/O, and return 0 for invalid inputs instead of aborting.
Compile with a sanitizer and verify one valid seed reaches the target with a temporary print or breakpoint.
falsifier: The harness crashes on a known-valid seed, returns before the target, or produces non-deterministic behavior.
